children.value: Annual per-capita health-care spending paired with life expectancy at birth for six wealthy nations, 1970–2020.
Our World in Data, combining OECD health-expenditure statistics (per-capita spending) with UN World Population Prospects (life expectancy), 1970–2020.
one of six countries: Canada, France, Germany, Great Britain, Japan, USA.
health-care spending per capita, in US dollars.
life expectancy at birth, in years.
274 — one row per country-year (coverage varies by country).

bar charts comparing budgets or outcomes across countries
